newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 77.0 bln marks in repos at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 77.0 bln marks in repos at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it allocated 77.0 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed interest rate of 3.00 percent.
A repo pact for 69.1 billion marks also allocated at a fixed 3.00 percent expires today, Wednesday, so a net 7.9 billion marks is flowing into the market.

The Bundesbank said banks bid for 210.8 billion marks of the 14-day repurchase funds this week. It accepted 36.5 percent of the bids made. The repo rate has been held steady at three percent since late August.
